Assuming you mean **Python** (the first one on the list):

**Developer velocity.**

Python lets you go from idea to working code in minutes. Dynamic typing, minimal syntax, and a massive standard library mean you spend time solving the actual problem instead of fighting the compiler or designing data layouts.

A data pipeline, a web scraper, a CLI tool, a prototype API — things that take 5–10 minutes in Python can take hours in Rust just to get past the type system. Rust rewards you at scale; Python rewards you *now*. For scripting, rapid prototyping, glue code, and data work, that speed difference is the single biggest practical advantage.
